author: TEDx Talks
description: How can a disease be considered "rare" when it affects 350 million people? In this compelling talk, the speaker unpacks one of healthcare's greatest paradoxes: thousands of rare diseases collectively impact a population larger than most countries. Through stories, research, and insight, he highlights the gaps in diagnosis, treatment, and awareness that leave millions searching for answers. By reframing rare diseases as a global challenge rather than isolated conditions, he offers a powerful vision for accelerating innovation and improving lives around the world. Dr. Zhenghong Gao is an internationally recognized scientist, drug developer, and biotech entrepreneur dedicated to transforming groundbreaking discoveries into life-saving therapies for patients worldwide. A trusted scientist-turned industry builder and cross-border strategist, he bridges the gap between pharma giants, cutting-edge biotechs, academia, and top-tier investors to translate early-stage breakthroughs into clinical
title: The not-so-rare world of rare diseases | Zhenghong Gao | TEDxApex

author: TEDx Talks
description:
From breaking newsrooms to personal crises, chaos is inevitable, but confusion doesn’t have to be. Mikaya Thurmond shares what high-stakes communication experiences have taught her about staying grounded, thinking clearly, and responding with intention when the world feels overwhelming. This talk is a guide to cutting through noise and finding clarity when it matters most. Mikaya Thurmond is a communications strategist, former television news anchor, and founder and CEO of Milan Public Relations. With more than 15 years of experience, she has worked at the intersection of media, leadership, and high-stakes messaging.

She spent seven years anchoring at WRAL in Raleigh, where she rose from reporter to weekday anchor, earning two Associated Press awards and four Emmy nominations. National outlets including CNN, The Weather Channel, CBS Evening News, and NBC’s Today Show regularly called on her for live breaking news coverage.

Today, Mikaya advises executives and mission-driven organiza
title: How to Find Clarity When the World Feels Loud | Mikaya Thurmond | TEDxNCState

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Like it or not, we’re all playing by rules we didn’t write. Victor George uses the familiar world of football to make regulation, ethics, and governance more accessible, showing how understanding the systems around us builds confidence instead of fear. This talk reframes rules not as restrictions, but as innovations that shape safer, smarter communities. Victor B. George, JD is a North Carolina based ethics and regulatory risk advisor and Principal Consultant at Ethixera Consulting. With a background in law, audit, and governance, he has advised Fortune 500 companies, global financial institutions, and emerging technology firms across the United States and internationally, helping organizations approach compliance with greater confidence and clarity.

A national speaker and author, Victor focuses on ethics, regulation, and how people make decisions inside complex systems. Drawing parallels to football, where rules are continually adapted to improve safety, fairness, and the game itsel
title: Closing the confidence gap that keeps us stuck | Victor George | TEDxNCState

author: TEDx Talks
description:
You've been told genius is rare. 

You've been told wrong. 

Paulina Amador reveals the hidden space where every breakthrough in human history was born - and why it already has your name on it. Paulina Amador is the founder of WEGeniusMinds, a Robbins-Madanes Life and Business Coaching Leader, TEDx speaker, bestselling author, host of the upcoming The Genius Zone Podcast, and creator of the groundbreaking documentary "EVOLUTION: The Genius Equation."
With over 25 years of experience, she empowers entrepreneurs, thought leaders, and changemakers to unlock their genius, amplify their voice, scale their businesses, and create lasting impact. Her radical mission: helping vissionary leaders remember that genius was never something to earn - it's something they've always possessed. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: You've already been a genius | Paulina Amador | TEDxPasedena | Paulina Amador | TEDxPasadena

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this video, Shrungar (A Movie & Theater Actor & a Podcastor) talks about; What if your empty days are not failure, but preparation? A powerful talk on patience, resilience, and growing through the waiting phase. Shrungar, a Media & Performance enthusiast with an MBA in PR from Symbiosis, pursued marketing and theatre for 8 years before making acting his full-time career in 2023. His work spans Gujarati films (Jhamkudi, Vash Level 2), Hindi web shows (Slumgolf), short films (B4tym, Gloomy Box), and multimedia shows (Viranjali 2.0, Namotsav) among others. Since 2020, he has hosted the Gujarati podcast A Night Before and runs KaviTales Media Productions to support emerging artists across Gujarat. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Power of Waiting | Shrungar Rughani | TEDxLakhotaLake

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We’ve been taught to edit ourselves - to streamline, specialise, and make ourselves easy to label. But what if that instinct to flatten is costing us our edge? In Becoming Magnetic, Dr Marina Hauer explores why depth, when articulated clearly, becomes a competitive advantage, and how individuals and organisations can use their layered identities to become unmistakable, unforgettable, and unignorable.

 Dr Marina Hauer is a humanist, strategist, and lifelong student of identity. Having lived and worked in four countries, speaking four languages, and holding three degrees - including a PhD - her career has zig-zagged across design, social science, and strategy. What has remained constant is her fascination with how individuals, cultures, and organisations make sense of who they are, and how that invisible logic shapes behaviour, belonging, and power.
Her work sits at the intersection of brand, leadership, and organisational behaviour, focusing not on how companies look, but on how they
title: Becoming Magnetic: The Competitive Advantage of Depth | Dr. Mariner Hauer | TEDxSwansea

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this video Dr. Kazomi (a Dermatologist & a specialist in dermato-surgery, aesthetics, and laser treatments) talks about why stigma, not skin, is the real disease. Dr. Kazomi Shingala is a dermatologist specializing in clinical dermatology, dermato-surgery, aesthetics, and laser treatments. Guided by evidence-based practice and innovation, she blends science with empathy to reveal the deeper connection between skin and self. For her, dermatology isn’t about vanity—it’s about stories. Through research, patient care, and storytelling, Dr. Shingala highlights how our skin reflects emotion, resilience, and the shared human experience beneath every surface. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The Skin We Wear | Dr Kazomi Shingala | TEDxLakhotaLake

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this video, Janvi Jogal (a professional music producer, composer & singer) performs her original songs Colour & Khaab which are also live on popular channels like Spotify, YT Music & Apple Music. Janvi Jogal is a music producer, singer, and songwriter whose work bridges heartfelt emotion with modern soundscapes. Beginning her musical journey at 12, she cultivated a love for creating background music for films and games. She trained in piano at KM Music Conservatory, Chennai, and earned a degree in music composition and production from the Australian Institute of Music, Sydney, where she lived and worked for six years. Now in India, Janvi blends global influences with her roots, crafting songs in English, Hindi, and Gujarati folk. Driven by a desire to translate real emotions into music, she produces, composes, and performs with authenticity, aiming to create a genre-defying sound that resonates deeply with listeners. Her mission is simple yet profound: to touch hearts through music
title: Colours & Khaab | Janvi Jogal | TEDxLakhotaLake

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Hospitality, at its core, is an act of humanity – the moment someone feels seen; the pause, the presence to show care. When your organization’s tagline is Hospitality with Heart & Soul, you must breathe life to these words. The five skills are not about doing more, they are about being more.

 Kathryn Harris has spent nearly three decades shaping how people learn, lead, and connect across the hospitality industry. Her career has taken her through every corner of the field—from fine dining and fast casual to casinos and national/international organizations—revealing a powerful truth: no matter the setting, the human connection is what drives exceptional experiences.
With a Master’s degree in Instructional Design and Technology, Kathryn has led learning and development at every organizational level. She is also the creator of HeartSkills, a framework built by studying what top performers do differently—and translating those behaviors into five essential human skills that elevate culture
title: Heart Skills – from Hospitality to Humanity   | Kathryn Harris | TEDxSwansea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
After surviving the 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings, a school leader reflects on how
to lead during extreme uncertainty. His key lesson is that in a crisis, leaders should focus on protecting people, communicating constantly, staying calm, and anchoring decisions to a clear purpose. When chaos destroys certainty, principles and purpose become the foundation that helps people move from fear and confusion to stability
and success. Jon is Headteacher in the Channel Islands. He has extensive leadership experience and has held senior roles including as an Executive Headteacher in the UK and Head of Secondary at one of the top schools in central Asia. Previously, Jon led school improvement in challenging contexts, driven by a commitment to social mobility and the belief that every child can succeed. Jon holds degrees in English and Modern English Studies, is a member of the Chartered College of Teaching, and is a qualified international school inspector. Married with four children, Jon suppo
title: Leading through Chaos | Jon Sindall | TEDxSt Helier

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We are always living in reality, but that reality is being created from the inside out.
 
At 17, after the sudden loss of his brother, James formed a quiet belief about himself that shaped his experience of life for years, influencing his relationships, confidence, and identity, even while succeeding on the outside.
 
In this powerful TEDx talk, he explores how our thoughts, meanings, and stories don’t just describe our lives, they create the reality we experience.  And when that’s seen clearly, a new beginning becomes possible.
 
 James has spent over 20 years supporting individuals through challenges and uncertainty, including more than 13 years as a Social Worker. His professional training in emotional regulation and leadership development is matched by lived experience.
Life has not always unfolded gently. Loss, failure, bankruptcy, divorce, and prolonged self-doubt have all shaped James’s journey. Like many, he formed internal stories about who he was and what was possible, stori
title: The Story That’s Running Your Life | James Phillips | TEDxSwansea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Technology was supposed to enhance our lives. And for the most part, it does. But it's also contributing to us feeling more isolated, more anxious, and more disconnected from each other. Helen's talk shares how we can reverse this tech takeover by introducing moments of intentional human connection into our daily lives. Small, simple things that remind us what we've forgotten: we are human by habit - and we can choose which habits to keep. Helen Joy founded People Spark after spending over a decade leading teams and watching good managers burn out under impossible expectations. She helps overstretched leaders build confident, capable teams, without the micromanaging or the meltdowns.
Her work is practical and human. No corporate jargon, no quick fixes,  just honest conversations about what actually works when you're leading people in the real world.
But her focus has expanded beyond leadership. Through A Million Human Moments, Helen is working to bring intentional connection back into
title: By Habbit | Helen Joy | TEDxSwansea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In change and uncertainty, we often reach for the same word: confidence. Earn it. Learn it. Build it. Fake it. What if that relentless pursuit has been one long, very convincing con - keeping us from who we truly are and the life we actually want. After a decade-long quest through modern neuroscience and ancient wisdom, self-confessed overthinker and recovered perfectionist Gitanjali discovered that our "confidence problem" is something far simpler to solve. With humour, heart and real life stories, she dismantles the con, names what's really keeping us stuck, and invites to see what's truly possible when we stop chasing confidence and start living as a Possiblist™. In a world filled with uncertainty, award-winning entrepreneur Gitanjali Trevorrow-Seymour is on a mission to fill it with Possiblists™. 
From acting on stage and screen to leading teams through the Global Financial Crisis to nearly losing her life to studying neuroscience, her unconventional path has fuelled a quest to di
title: The Confidence Con: What if nothing's missing?  | Gitanjali Trevorrow-Seymour | TEDxSwansea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this deeply personal talk, Derek Nelson reflects on how loss can teach us powerful lessons.  His story reveals how gratitude can live alongside sorrow, how overcoming does not mean erasing pain, and how true resilience is built moment by moment.  Derek’s message ultimately points us towards living every day as if it truly matters.

 Derek is on a quest to become the best version of himself while helping others do the same. A former pediatric bedside nurse and Ironman triathlon finisher, he has spent over 20 years as a professional sales executive and entrepreneur. He holds a Bachelor of Nursing and an MBA from the University of Utah, credentials that reflect his unique blend of heart-led service and strategic leadership.
Today, as the owner of Best Self Systems, LLC, Derek focuses on the valuable lessons found in life’s most challenging transitions. Living in Kaysville, Utah, he is most at home hiking or cycling in the nearby mountains. Above all, he treasures his roles as a husban
title: “How Loss Taught Me Presence.” | Derek Nelson | TEDxSwansea

author: TEDx Talks
description:
モデル・タレントとして華やかなキャリアを築きながらも、心身の不調やアイデンティティの葛藤を経験したローラ。日本とバングラデシュ、二つの文化の間で育った彼女は、アメリカでの生活を経て、「本当の自分らしさ」とは何かを問い直していきます。

断捨離、運動、茶道、そして新潟の山奥での農業との出会いを通して、彼女は自然と調和しながら丁寧に生きることの大切さに気づきました。本トークでは、現代社会の中で見失いがちな「心と体のつながり」、日本文化が持つ mindfulness（今を生きる力）、そして食や自然との関わりについて、自身の人生経験をもとに語ります。

自分らしく生きることとは何か。忙しい日常の中で、本当に大切なものをどう取り戻すのか。ローラが実体験を通して届ける、癒しと再生のストーリーです。

After building a successful career as a model and television personality, ROLA found herself struggling with burnout, anxiety, and a loss of identity. Raised between Japanese and Bangladeshi cultures, and later transformed by her experiences in the United States, she began questioning what it truly means to live authentically.

Through movement, minimalism, Japanese tea ceremony, and eventually farming in the mountains of Niigata, ROLA rediscovered the importance of living in harmony with nature and caring for both mind and body. In this talk, she shares her personal journey of healing and self-discovery while exploring mindfulness in Japanes
title: 自分を愛する事。そして土の上で裸足になろう！　Love Yourself, Barefoot on the Earth. | Rola ローラ | TEDxMarunouchi

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Cuántas veces te has quedado en la puerta de una oportunidad por miedo a entrar, pensando que no eres suficiente? No importa si eres un gobernador enfrentando un debate, una empresaria brillante en una junta de consejo o un profesional con años de trayectoria; el síndrome del impostor y el miedo al rechazo son heridas que aprendimos en la infancia y que hoy cargamos en silencio.

En esta charla, Vero comparte una perspectiva que sacude el mundo del liderazgo: tu cuerpo es el archivo viviente de tus creencias. A través de su propia vulnerabilidad, Vero nos revela cómo hackeó su propia mente destruida a través de la postura corporal frente al espejo.

Olvídate de intentar controlar solo tus pensamientos. Tu cuerpo tiene el poder de rescatar a tu mente. Descubre cómo dejar de hacerte chiquito, cómo ocupar tu espacio con autoridad y cómo proyectar esa primera carta de presentación que define cómo te percibe el mundo.  Estratega con 25 años de experiencia que entiende que la verdadera ima
title: La identidad que aprendimos a ser | Verónica Ríos | TEDxPlazaFundadores

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Te ha pasado que apagas la luz para dormir, pero tu mente enciende una pantalla a todo color para recordarte cada uno de tus errores y temores? Esta charla nos confronta con una realidad que casi todos intentamos ocultar: vivimos siendo esclavos y víctimas de nuestros propios pensamientos. 

Mario descubrió que el secreto del verdadero bienestar no consiste en "dejar de sentir" o en intentar bloquear el estrés, sino en desarrollar una habilidad clave que pocos nos enseñan: la capacidad de recuperarnos rápido.

Deja de ser un empleado sumiso de tus pensamientos y toma el control responsable de tu vida. La pregunta no es qué te está pasando afuera, sino quién está al mando aquí dentro. Mario Córdova es el fundador de Operadora SI, un grupo con presencia nacional en sectores como hotelería, salud e inmobiliaria. A lo largo de su trayectoria, ha integrado el éxito empresarial con la academia y el compromiso social, desempeñándose como patrono de organizaciones dedicadas a la niñez.

title: Mi fábrica de pensamientos | Mario Córdova | TEDxPlazaFundadores

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Women are not disappearing from STEM by accident.

In this TEDx talk, Dr. Shadé Kolade challenges the popular idea of a “leaky pipeline” and argues that underrepresentation is often the result of systems and structures that filter talent out over time. She invites us to stop asking how to fix women and start asking what we’ve built that keeps them out. Dr. Shadé is a microbiology professor, leadership consultant, and academic researcher whose work sits at the intersection of science, leadership, and equity. Trained in STEM and shaped by lived experience, her career spans research, teaching, and leadership development across academic and professional environments.

Through her work, Dr. Shadé has witnessed firsthand the persistent gaps facing women in STEM, not only in representation but in how success, competence, and belonging are defined and measured. Drawing on research, advocacy, and leadership practice, she challenges conventional narratives about women in science and technology
title: We're Asking The Wrong Question About Women in STEM | Shade Kolade | TEDxWaverley

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the discomfort you’re trying to avoid is actually trying to help you?

After spending years living on autopilot, following expectations that no longer fit, Tam Kroeker began to notice a deeper pattern: the moments that made her most uncomfortable were often pointing to truths she had been ignoring. In this TEDx talk, she explores how discomfort can become a powerful invitation to greater awareness, authenticity, and a life that feels fully awake. Tam Kroeker is a Winnipeg‑based Enneagram coach, speaker, and educator, and the founder of EnneagramAWARE. Formerly an elementary school teacher, she shifted careers to focus on leadership development and personal growth through self‑awareness. Her work supports individuals and teams in understanding core motivations, strengthening relationships, and creating healthier workplace cultures. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.
title: The Half-Asleep Life | Tam Kroeker | TEDxWaverley

author: TEDx Talks
description:
After navigating profound loss and years of personal transformation, Linda Drosdowech discovered an unexpected truth: the biggest obstacle to achieving our goals is often not a lack of strategy, but our desire to avoid discomfort.

In this TEDx talk, she explores why courage, growth, and success depend on our willingness to experience difficult emotions and why the point is not to feel good, but to get good at feeling. Linda Drosdowech is an international keynote speaker, executive coach, and leadership educator who helps high-achieving people lead through change with clarity, courage, and self-trust. Her work is shaped by lived experience—navigating major life transitions, rebuilding from uncertainty, and learning how to keep showing up with strength even when the ground shifts underneath you.
Known for her warmth, humour, and practical tools, Linda blends real talk with real strategy. She is the creator of the 7 Steps Forward framework, a simple and powerful approach to mindset, com
title: The Point Is Not To Feel Good | Linda Drosdowech | TEDxWaverley

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Why do so many capable people struggle to be seen?

Drawing from her experiences as a mother, immigrant, and business professional rebuilding her career, Margarita Serova challenges the belief that visibility is a confidence problem. She argues that for many people, the real barrier is overload. In this TEDx talk, she explores how invisible responsibilities, expectations, and roles can keep us hidden and why creating space may be the key to being seen again. Margarita Serova is a marketer, entrepreneur, and community builder with over 20 years of experience across international markets. After immigrating to Canada with two children, she rebuilt her career from the ground up — transforming personal disruption into purpose-driven work.
 
She is the founder of Biz Moms, an ecosystem supporting mothers in entrepreneurship and professional careers, and leads a visibility and positioning consultancy, where she helps professionals and organizations build strong personal brands, strategic rel
title: You Can't Be Visible While Holding Everything | Margarita Serova | TEDxWaverley

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world pulling students in a hundred directions, clarity can feel impossible. Dr. Dar Mayweather challenges the pressure to “do it all” by revealing how vision, gifts, vehicle, purpose, and belief can align around one defining focus. This talk offers a powerful reminder that success doesn’t come from chasing everything, rather it comes from choosing the one thing that moves you forward. Based in Wilmington, North Carolina, Dr. Mayweather is a leadership educator, speaker, and founder of Good Mayweather Consulting. A first-generation college student whose academic journey began with significant setbacks, he went on to earn a doctorate in Educational Leadership and now serves as a faculty member at the University of North Carolina Wilmington.

Through his teaching, coaching, and national speaking engagements, Dr. Mayweather helps students and professionals move from confusion to clarity by identifying the one thing that unlocks their potential. His work challenges the belief that su
title: All You Need Is One Thing: Finding Clarity in a Distracted World | Dar Mayweather | TEDxNCState

author: TEDx Talks
description: We are all contagious. The way we think about ourselves, speak to ourselves, and show up in the world spreads further than we realize. When Sam recognized this, she chose to become contagious on purpose. That decision helped her turn a struggling business profitable in 90 days and led her to an unexpected path through comedy, storytelling, and personal transformation. In this talk, she reveals how authentic congruence can change not only your own life, but every room you walk into. Sam Ghanem is a Best Friend, Fractional CMO, Brand Strategist, and TEDx speaker with 24 years of experience specializing in aligning print, messaging, marketing, and systems for scalable growth. As Founder of SG INK, she has partnered with Lockheed Martin, Danaher, Mercedes-Benz, and Thermo Fisher, delivering measurable results across industries. When Sam recognized she was truly contagious, she chose to become contagious on purpose - completely avoiding bankruptcy, drug rehab, and endless therapeutic modal
title: It's Contagious | The Way You Treat Yourself Spreads | Sam Ghanem | TEDxApex

author: TEDx Talks
description:
COVID-19 was more than a global health crisis, it was a stress test for systems everywhere.

In this TEDx talk, Obidimma Ezezika reveals why organizations, institutions, and even people struggle when change happens faster than they can adapt. He argues that lasting success is not about moving faster, but about building the capacity to absorb, rebalance, and thrive under pressure. Dr. Obidi Ezezika is a global health scholar who studies how ideas turn into real-world change. He is an Associate Professor at Western University, where he directs the Global Health & Innovation Lab. His work examines how proven innovations move from evidence to sustained impact within complex systems. Working across Africa and Canada, he explores why progress so often falters — not because ideas are weak, but because systems lose balance during change. Through his research, teaching, and public engagement, Obidi focuses on alignment, trust, and integration as the often-overlooked foundations of lasting tran
title: When Systems Move Too Fast: The Hidden Risk of Acceleration | Obidi Ezezika | TEDxWaverley

author: TEDx Talks
description: What if technology's greatest potential isn't to replace human intelligence—but to strengthen it? Drawing from his personal experience overcoming mental health struggles, Shane became fascinated by how the brain learns, adapts, and heals. Today, he explores how emerging technologies can support human growth, resilience, and connection. Through his work and the Catalyst Community, he is helping the next generation navigate the intersection of technology, business, and mental wellness in a rapidly changing world. Shane Pope is the founder of Reflect Technology, a company focused on using technology to advance human thriving. After struggling with his own mental health for years, Shane eventually received the life-changing care he needed. That experience led him to get extremely curious about how the brain processes and stores information. He sees technology as a tool for humans to use to their advantage, not something to replace and infringe on what makes us human. He is also building T
title: It's Time For A Human Revolution | Shane Pope | TEDxApex

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Many of us spend our lives chasing goals, solving problems, and moving on to the next thing. But what happens when productivity becomes the only way we know how to live?

Drawing from a deeply personal experience as a new father, Chris Hoquis reveals why doing everything right can still feel empty and how rediscovering presence can help us reconnect with what makes life meaningful. Chris Hoquis is an entrepreneur, educator, and product builder based in Winnipeg, Canada. With over 20 years of experience across technology, marketing, and product development, he has spent his career building things while helping others learn how to navigate complexity, pressure, and change. He teaches at the university level, where his work with students grounds much of his thinking about ambition, identity, and the emotional realities of modern work. Chris is the founder of Rally the Locals, a platform dedicated to amplifying local stories and small businesses, and the co-founder of Hostly, a social exp
title: Why Doing Everything Right Still Feels Empty | Chris Hoquis | TEDxWaverley

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Kararlarımızı gerçekten biz mi veriyoruz, yoksa farkında olmadan psikolojimizin yönlendirmelerine mi uyuyoruz? Onur Okan Demirci konuşmasında insan davranışlarının arkasındaki psikolojik süreçleri, düşüncelerimizin ve duygularımızın hayatımız üzerindeki etkisini anlatıyor. Dr. Onur Okan Demirci, İnönü Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi’nden mezun olduktan sonra psikiyatri alanında uzmanlaşmış ve Bakırköy Prof. Dr. Mazhar Osman Ruh Sağlığı ve Sinir Hastalıkları Hastanesi’nde eğitimini tamamlamıştır.

EMDR alanında uluslararası düzeyde eğitimler almış olan Demirci, İngiltere Ulusal Terapistler Birliği’nden EMDR diplomasına sahiptir. Binlerce vaka deneyimiyle geliştirdiği bütüncül psikoterapi yaklaşımıyla danışanlarına hizmet vermektedir.
Profesyonel yaşamı boyunca 35’ten fazla ülkede bulunmuş, travma alanında çalışmalar yürütmüş ve bu alandaki bazı çalışmalarını bilimsel literatüre kazandırmıştır. EMDR ve psikiyatrik tedavilerin karşılaştırıldığı araştırmasıyla literatüre öncü katkılarda bulunm
title: Psikoloji mi İnsanı, İnsan mı Psikolojiyi Yönetir | Onur Okan Demirci | TEDxMCFL Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this TEDx talk, Dean shares how he went from leaving school with minimal qualifications and working numerous jobs to founding a thriving air conditioning business. He explains how lockdown created unexpected demand, fuelling his growth and leading him to join The Apprentice to prove what he was capable of. Facing challenges and being underestimated, Dean talks about turning  doubts into motivation. His message is clear: believe in yourself, use doubt as fuel, and step beyond your comfort zone Dean is an entrepreneur, winner of The Apprentice 2025, and founder of ADL Air Conditioning. Starting with very little, Dean built his business from the ground up into a successful company, driven by resilience, ambition and sharp business instinct. His journey reflects a commitment to hard work, adaptability and taking calculated risks in pursuit of growth. Through his experience in both business and on one of the UK’s most competitive platforms, Dean has developed a practical, no-nonsense ap
title: The value of being underestimated | Dean Franklin | TEDxSt Helier

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Danielle’s talk explores the catalysts that led her to becoming an accidental activist
and poet. Danielle begins with her poem Love Letter (To all the Good Men) and her
call to action in Irish ‘Ní neart go cur le chéile’ meaning there is no strength without
unity. Danielle asks all of us to believe survivors of abuse when they share their
stories and how our allyship is a powerful force for healing and change. Danielle was
moved to action because of her own lived experience growing up in a home with
domestic abuse and the scale of violence affecting women and girls globally. As a
secondary school teacher working with young women and girls every day and seeing
rising femicide across communities, Danielle knew she had to speak up and take
action. When her students asked ‘What are we going to do about this Mrs Mynes?’
Danielle listened. With her students, they organised a candlelit vigil in her school.
Danielle develops grassroots student activism platforms for her students; initiatives
title: Being Believed: How Voice, Education, and Activism Change Lives | Danielle Mynes | TEDxSt Helier
